summary: Digest-bound prerequisites for first native adoption

delivery.outcome: Deliver the existing prerequisite-seed repair and standard0.20.133 with full independent publication; declare the existing PyYAML worktree-guard test prerequisite in CI so an isolated runtime can execute every required check. Product implementation remains unchanged.
nonGoals: No consumer edits, legacy owner takeover, arbitrary file creation, overwrite, policy weakening or default seeding.
No writer/publication authority in a seed plan or installer receipt; existing native allocation and independent approval remain mandatory.

architecture.decision: An optional bounded external closed JSON plan binds current target HEAD and literal content/digests for only absent required VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, TODO.md and project/TICKETS.md. Validate symlink/commit absence and reread before effects; create exclusively and include exact bytes in the existing bootstrap receipt. Existing first-allocation, ownership and independent protected publication guards remain unchanged.
interfaceChanges: Opt-in --bootstrap-prerequisites-plan for explicit first bootstrap only
dataChanges: Closed external new-project.bootstrap-prerequisites-plan/v1 plan; existing receipt format unchanged
architecture.rollback: Protected revert; retain old immutable standard releases. Never use unreviewed candidate in actual consumer repositories.

commands: targeted bootstrap CLI and first-allocation regressions
validation.evidence: Successful read-only review, bounded seed installation and exact native first allocation; existing target bytes/foreign paths preserved.
Invalid or changed plans make no writes; default missing-prerequisite refusal unchanged.
No consumer use before independent source merge and actual canonical published0.20.133 release.
